description: Splits polyphonic cables in two, one output carrying the first channels and the other the rest, for four cables at once

params.text: Sets how many channels go to the A outputs, a whole number from 0 to 16, with the rest going to the B outputs

inputs.text: A polyphonic signal to be split, its channels divided between the A and B outputs of its own row

outputs.text: The first channels of its row's input, as many of them as the Channels knob sets
The channels of its row's input beyond the ones sent to the A output

notes: the split point is worked out from the widest of the four inputs, so all four rows split at the same channel; the displays show the input, A and B channel counts
